preconditions.description: The number of abbreviations to process is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each abbreviation contains at most nine digits.
preconditions.description: Each abbreviation has at most nine digits, which represent the year's last digits.

postconditions.expression: For each abbreviation, find the year of the corresponding Olympiad.
postconditions.description: The output should list the year for each given abbreviation, starting from 1989 and incrementing by 1 for each subsequent Olympiad.
